scope: Static alluvial river corridors: exposed inner bars, deeper outer bends and transported bank materials.
status: Implementation and scalar checks complete; actual-world, native visual and performance checks pending.

sources.use: Floodplain and point-bar deposition varies with discharge and flood history; use finite coherent channel-aligned deposits.
Low-gradient meanders erode outer banks and deposit inside bends.
Braided channels require actual branching/merging networks; do not label this single-channel bar update as braided rivers.

performance_design: Prepare bounded coefficients with existing lazy river spans.
No extra scenery objects, materials, water ribbons, draw calls or per-frame simulation.
Use the existing shared physical sampler and existing sand/gravel surface layers.
Actual native fixed-site movement/turning comparison required before acceptance.
limits: No migration through time, distributary deltas, braided networks or dynamic flood sediment transport in this feature.
Bar dimensions and coefficients are bounded game approximations.

correctness.point_bar_mesh_checks: Three actual point-bar meshes at102.4/64,204.8/32,3276.8/16 have finite water and contained bank edges using actual refined land triangles.

existing_failure.original_edge_result: The 0.209m ocean-mouth result was a diagnostic false positive: the old test interpolated the original regular grid instead of actual refined terrain triangles. Corrected to indexed triangle interpolation.
existing_failure.remaining_assertion: Water shaping raised terrain instead of cutting its bed: river-2134. Reproduces with both old B0c6 assemblies and candidate, after the corrected edge check passes. Full suite therefore remains failing, not claimed accepted.

visual_review.first_alluvial_run: Rejected: wide camera was beyond useful reveal fog and ground camera faced away from river. Framing corrected; new capture pending.
visual_review.meandering_context: Native runtime reports21checks PASS; launcher could not find a hidden window after capture. Changed offscreen script to explicit batchmode, with rightmost-monitor argument for any platform window.
